def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants
    species_map = {
        'adelie': 'Adelie', 'Adelie': 'Adelie',
        'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap', 'Chinstrap': 'Chinstrap',
        'gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'Gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'Gentto': 'Gentoo',
    }
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().map(species_map)
    # flipper_length_mm stored as text -> numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # Out-of-range flipper lengths -> NaN
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # body_mass_g stored as text -> numeric (not needed for the answer, but tidy)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])
    means = d.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in means.items()}
